misreadings.quote: Outside the door, the family celebrates their "exorcism."
misreadings.evidence: no support in the text; the family's reaction is the sister's "At last!" ("as she turned the key in the lock she said loudly to her parents 'At last!'"). The father had just sat with his arms around her "in unhappy silence", and the mother had "fallen completely asleep". Nobody celebrates, and no one speaks of an exorcism.
misreadings.explanation: The text shows only the sister's relieved exclamation, with the parents silent or asleep, so a family celebration and an "exorcism" are not in the text.

result.note: Almost all of the reflection is interpretation or metaphor that stays close to the text; the only unsupported claim stated as fact is that the family celebrates an exorcism.
